challenge_binding_valid.name: challenge_binding_valid
challenge_binding_valid.value: ("blacklist"."staff_webauthn_challenges"."purpose" = 'enroll' and (("blacklist"."staff_webauthn_challenges"."flow_id" is not null and "blacklist"."staff_webauthn_challenges"."invitation_id" is not null and "blacklist"."staff_webauthn_challenges"."user_id" is null) or ("blacklist"."staff_webauthn_challenges"."flow_id" is null and "blacklist"."staff_webauthn_challenges"."user_id" is not null and "blacklist"."staff_webauthn_challenges"."session_id" is not null))) or ("blacklist"."staff_webauthn_challenges"."purpose" <> 'enroll' and "blacklist"."staff_webauthn_challenges"."user_id" is not null)

transaction_snapshot_family.name: transaction_snapshot_family
transaction_snapshot_family.value: ("blacklist"."chain_transactions"."block_number" IS NOT NULL AND "blacklist"."chain_transactions"."block_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "blacklist"."chain_transactions"."slot" IS NULL) OR ("blacklist"."chain_transactions"."slot" IS NOT NULL AND "blacklist"."chain_transactions"."block_number" IS NULL AND "blacklist"."chain_transactions"."block_hash" IS NULL)
